description: Use when a stairlift owner has a repair quote and asks whether the repair is still worth it: "Treppenlift Reparatur lohnt sich", "Treppenlift 12 Jahre alt Reparatur 2.000 Euro", "Treppenlift reparieren oder neu kaufen". Compares the quote with the lower end of the new price including installation for a straight or curved stair and takes the age of the lift into account (rule of thumb from the calculator on treppenliftvergleichsportal.de: below a quarter repair, a quarter to a half depends on age, over a half get quotes, at or above the new price replace).
